name: Draw Basic Shapes
description:
Draw basic geometric shapes on an ActivInspire flipchart canvas.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart in ActivInspire (File > New Flipchart or Ctrl+N)
2. Use the shape tools to draw the following shapes on the canvas:
   - A rectangle (any size, any color)
   - A circle or ellipse (any size, any color)
3. The shapes should be clearly visible on the flipchart page
4. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/shapes_lesson.flipchart' (File > Save As or Ctrl+Shift+S)

Hints:
- There is no pre-existing flipchart - you must create a new one first
- Shape tools are typically in the toolbar or can be accessed via Insert menu
- In ActivInspire, look for a Shapes button/menu that shows various geometric shapes
- You can draw shapes by selecting the shape tool, then clicking and dragging on the canvas
